name: Project: Catalepsy
summary:
Project: Catalepsy is a haunting third-person action roguelike that plunges players into a visceral interpretation of Christian Hell. As a lone wanderer, you must descend through a procedurally generated abyss of 20 unforgiving levels where the only way out is deeper in.

Before every descent, players must strategically architect their build, combining active and passive skills with ancient amulets and risk-reward modifiers. Survival demands mastery of combat and character synergy, with formidable boss encounters guarding every fifth floor. While the abyss is lethal, death is merely a transition: collect Blood Shards to unlock permanent upgrades and return stronger. Experience a fully 3D dark fantasy world where strategic depth meets uncompromising tension, and every run is a step closer to uncovering what lies at the heart of the pit.
